Amhaz n yiṭij yeshelǧay tazmert n yiṭij (tiftilin yettwannisnin). Ma yella yuli umaz, d win ara yerran aɣbel n uquṛḥ n tfekka (tizi), aṭṭan n lehlak n uglim (serṭan) d uɛeggu n tiṭṭawin d win yettnernin s lemɣawla.
Akud uɣrid n uquṛḥ yegdel ɣef teɣzi (altitude), lqaɛa yettafen am aman neɣ adfel, ṣṣifa n uglim-inek, d useqdec n uɣdid n yiṭij.
Ɣef wswir n teẓdi n waḍu
Aswir n teẓdi n waḍu (ATA) d amhaz yettwassenulfan akken ad ak-yeǧǧ ad tfehmeḍ amek i teẓẓa teẓdi n waḍu deg kra n lǧiha, d yiblaḍen izemren ad awḍen taafsa-inek.

Aswir yettuseqdacen deg usnas-agi yebedd ɣef yisumar n Tuddsa Tamaḍlant n Tezmert (who), mačči ɣef yilugan n tmurt, akken ad yili wazal n tfulyin d yiluɣa yelhan, yerna ad yehwu usemsawi n teẓdi n waḍu gar tmura.
Aswir n wamhaz n teẓdi n waḍu
Teẓdi n waḍu telha nezzeh i teɣzi n wemdan; zemreḍ ad tsekneḍ tiwuriwin-ik timezwura n berra.
Teẓdi n waḍu telha s umata i waṭas n yimdanen. Lameɛna, wid iɣef tbedd tezmert s wudem ur nqubil zemren ad ḥussen s kra n waṭṭanen imecṭuḥen neɣ imectahen seg ufsar uɛlayan.

Teẓdi n waḍu tewweḍ ɣer yiwen n uswir uɛlayan n tɣuri, yerna ur telhi ara i wid yellan s tezmert ur nqubil. Nqes lweqt i tɛeddiḍ berra ma yella tḥusseḍ s kra n yizmal am ugur n tnefsit neɣ tuccḍa n ṭjur.

Akk n tezmert zemren ad ttwaxeddmen srid i wid iɣef tbedd tezmert. Wid yellan d iɛlayanen zemren ad ḥussen s wuguren n tnefsit d tuccḍa n ṭjur mi ara ɛeddin lweqt ɣef beṛṛa. Beddel neɣ nqes tiwuriwin-ik n beṛṛa.

Iɣbula n tezmert zemren ad ttwaxeddmen srid i wid iɣef tbedd tezmert, yerna iwata ad ǧǧen tiwuriwin n beṛṛa. Wid yellan d iɛlayanen zemren ad ḥussen s wuguren n tnefsit d tuccḍa n ṭjur; ɣileɣ ad qqimen deg uxxam neɣ ad sserksen tiwuriwin-nni n beṛṛa.
Afsar akk n waḍu, ula d kra kan n tesdatin, izmer ad yawi ɣer tegnit n tezmert tawaɣit i yal yiwen. Ǧǧeḍ tiwuriwin n beṛṛa.

Azal n usellel d taẓɣelt iɣef ilaq ad yiberdi wakud/tegnit akken ad yawweḍ aẓeṭṭab amseḍfir ɣer %s.

Aɣbel n tegnit d aɣbel n wadda i d-yeṭṭafaren seg tegnit n wakal. Asnas-agi yessqedac aɣbel n tegnit n tlisa n yill (MSLP) akken ad yezmer yiwen ad yessemsawi aɣbel gar yimukan yesɛan tiɣziwin yemgaraden s lqelleɛ.

Imedyazen imeqqranen yerna ɣezzifen di uɣbel ttwaseqdacen akken ad nɛasseḍ ibeddilen n tegnit. Amedya, aɣelluy n uɣbel yezmer ad d-yini d akken aɣli n waman neɣ n udfel qrib ad d-yawweḍ, ma d asali n uɣbel yezmer ad d-yini d akken tegnit ad teḥfu. Aɣbel n tegnit aramay yezmer ad d-yawi iɣimiwen n uqjun (icebban n uqjun), leɛtab n yizuran, leɛya d waṭas n wammaken nniḍen.
Tannayt tesskanay-ak arnu ad twaliḍ s telqayt ayen yezgan di teɣzi am tiɣremtin d yidurar. Tannayt tezmer ad tt-yessemsawi uɣli n waman, tagut, akal (aɣebbar), aseɣlu neɣ adɣaɣ.
Aɣummu n lɣimam yeqqen ɣer temrawt n igenwan i yettwaguɣmen s lɣimam s wudem amagnu. Aɣummu-agi yeqqen daɣen ɣer teɣzi n tfukt.
